pages.title: Blank Flashcards
pages.desc: Free printable blank flashcard template. Type into the cells or print them empty to write by hand, then print or save as a PDF. No download or signup.
pages.blurb: A clean blank flashcard template — a full page of roomy cells you can type into or print empty and fill in by hand. Perfect for study terms, vocabulary, or any prompt-and-answer pair you want to make yourself.
pages.tip: Every cell is click-to-type. Print double-sided so your answers land behind their prompts, or print fronts only for single-sided cards.

pages.title: Multiplication Flashcards
pages.desc: Free printable multiplication flashcards, 0-12 times tables. Front shows the fact, back shows the computed answer. Print double-sided or save as a PDF. No signup.
pages.blurb: The complete set of multiplication facts from 0 to 12 — every fact on the front, the answer on the back. Answers are computed, never mistyped, so the whole deck is guaranteed correct.
pages.tip: That's the full 0-12 deck (169 cards) across several pages. Print double-sided and flip on the long edge so each answer prints behind its fact.

pages.title: Addition Flashcards
pages.desc: Free printable addition flashcards, sums 0-12. Front shows the problem, back shows the computed answer. Print double-sided or save as a PDF. No signup.
pages.blurb: Addition facts from 0 to 12 with every sum on the back — the full deck, computed so every answer is correct. Great for kindergarten and early-grade math-fact practice.
pages.tip: That's the full 0-12 deck (169 cards) across several pages. Print double-sided and flip on the long edge so each answer prints behind its problem.

pages.title: Division Flashcards
pages.desc: Free printable division flashcards, divisors 1-12. Every fact divides evenly; the back shows the computed quotient. Print double-sided or save as a PDF. No signup.
pages.blurb: Division facts for divisors 1 through 12 — every problem divides evenly with no remainders, and the quotient is on the back. Built by construction from the multiplication facts, so every answer is correct.
pages.tip: That's 144 cards across several pages. Print double-sided and flip on the long edge so each quotient prints behind its problem.

pages.title: Sight Words Flashcards
pages.desc: Free printable sight word flashcards — the first 40 Fry / Dolch high-frequency words for early readers. Print, cut, and practice, or save as a PDF. No signup.
pages.blurb: The 40 most common sight words (Fry's first list, overlapping the Dolch words) — the ones early readers should recognize instantly rather than sound out. One word per card, big and clear.
pages.tip: These read the same on both sides, so print single-sided to save paper, or double-sided if you want the word visible whichever way a card faces.

pages.title: Alphabet Letter Flashcards
pages.desc: Free printable alphabet flashcards, A to Z. Front shows the uppercase letter, back shows the matching lowercase. Print double-sided or save as a PDF. No signup.
pages.blurb: The full alphabet, A to Z — uppercase on the front and the matching lowercase on the back. A simple, clear set for teaching letter recognition and upper/lowercase pairs.
pages.tip: Print double-sided and flip on the long edge so each lowercase letter lands behind its uppercase partner.

pages.title: Number Flashcards (0-20)
pages.desc: Free printable number flashcards, 0 to 20. Front shows the numeral, back shows the number word. Print double-sided or save as a PDF. No signup.
pages.blurb: Numbers 0 through 20 — the numeral on the front and the spelled-out word on the back (7 / seven). Good for number recognition and connecting figures to their names.
pages.tip: Print double-sided and flip on the long edge so each number word prints behind its numeral.

pages.title: States and Capitals Flashcards
pages.desc: Free printable US states and capitals flashcards — all 50 states. Front shows the state, back shows its capital. Print double-sided or save as a PDF. No signup.
pages.blurb: All 50 US states with their capitals — the state on the front, the capital on the back. A complete, correct set for geography study and quizzing.
pages.tip: Print double-sided and flip on the long edge so each capital lands behind its state.

pages.title: Spanish Flashcards
pages.desc: Free printable Spanish vocabulary flashcards — 30 common words. Front shows English, back shows the Spanish word. Print double-sided or save as a PDF. No signup.
pages.blurb: Thirty common Spanish words for beginners — the English word on the front and its Spanish translation on the back. Everyday vocabulary like colors, numbers, family, and greetings.
pages.tip: Print double-sided and flip on the long edge so each Spanish word lands behind its English prompt.
